questions.question: Which stack and auth should I build on?

options.label: Next.js + Better Auth (Recommended)
options.description: Next.js App Router (TS, Tailwind), Better Auth for email/password + sessions, Drizzle ORM. One process, fully self-hosted, no auth vendor lock-in.

options.label: Next.js + Auth.js (NextAuth v5)
options.description: Same app shell, but NextAuth for auth. More providers out of the box, clunkier session/DB typing.

options.label: Next.js + Clerk
options.description: Hosted auth UI and user management. Fastest auth surface, but requires Clerk keys and adds a vendor dependency.

options.label: FastAPI + React SPA
options.description: Python API with JWT auth and a separate Vite/React frontend. Two processes to run.

options.label: Stripe subscriptions (Recommended)
options.description: Checkout for plan signup, Billing Portal for card/cancel, webhook sync of subscription state, paywall gating. Runs in Stripe test mode with no live keys.

options.label: Stripe one-time payments
options.description: Simpler credit-pack / lifetime purchase model. No recurring plans or portal.

options.label: Paddle / Lemon Squeezy
options.description: Merchant-of-record handles tax/VAT. Different SDK and webhook shapes.

options.label: Local Postgres + orgs (Recommended)
options.description: Postgres in Docker with migrations and seed data; multi-tenant teams with owner/admin/member roles and per-org subscriptions.

options.label: SQLite + single-user accounts
options.description: Zero infra, file DB, personal accounts only. Fastest to run, least realistic for SaaS.

options.label: Supabase (hosted)
options.description: Hosted Postgres + its own auth. Overlaps with the auth choice above.

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: launchpad-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: launchpad
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: launchpad
      POSTGRES_DB: launchpad
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - launchpad-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U launchpad -d launchpad"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

volumes:
  launchpad-db:
